observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor room with tall bookshelves lining the walls, library or studio setting
observation.dancers: mixed group of young adults, about seven men and one woman; dancers take turns solo in the center while others watch and cheer
observation.formation_and_space: dancers stand in a loose semi-circle in front of bookshelves; soloists dance in the center space
observation.posture: upright or slightly leaned forward torso, knees bent with bouncy weight shifts
observation.footwork: fast steps, high knee lifts, kicks, heel digs, and rapid weight changes on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms move actively in coordination with leg movements, pumping or gesturing; hands relaxed or clenched into soft fists
observation.hips_and_torso: bouncy torso movement with occasional slight torso dips and bounces
observation.levels_jumps_turns: mostly low and medium levels with occasional jumps, sudden drops to one hand on the floor, and quick turns
observation.costume_and_props: casual streetwear including t-shirts, hoodies, jeans, caps, and sneakers
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and precise weight distribution are obscured by fast movement and low-resolution framing

signature_moments.what: solo dancer performs rapid high knee raises and foot stamps while pumping arms
female dancer steps energetically with high kicks and body bounces in place
dancer executes quick directional foot shuffles and alternating heel taps
dancer maintains a low bouncy stance with rapid alternating knee lifts
dancer drops down quickly, placing one hand on the floor while kicking legs out
